# Lit recovery release qualification

The three candidate archives were built from recovery commit `8099119`
with the locked dependencies. Each archive contains the executable and
the unchanged MIT license from `98c59bb`. Both Linux executables
require glibc 2.39. The binaries report the inherited version `lit 1.0.0`.

| Test host | Target | Strict sandbox result | Focused Rust regressions |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| macOS | Apple Silicon | Filesystem and network confinement passed | 35 passed |
| host-a | Linux x86-64 | Filesystem and network confinement passed | 35 passed |
| host-e | Linux arm64 | Refused to launch before the payload ran | |
| host-f | Linux arm64 | Refused to launch before the payload ran | 35 passed |

All four hosts passed batch dry-run validation, rollback of a provisional
commit, and retry. The smoke test also exercised MCP tool discovery and
writes over stdio and loopback HTTP. Git clone, fetch, pull, and push
passed against disposable file, smart HTTP, authenticated HTTPS, and
authenticated SSH remotes. Migration and rollback passed on each host
using repositories made by the released v1.8.0 binary as well as the
recovery candidate.

The macOS v1.8.0 reference returned `GENERAL_ERROR` with empty suggestions
for the advertised `op` form, including dry-run. The canonical
`command` and `args` form passed validation and staged the fixture when
executed. On the same reference binary, native bare clone failed,
native pull left stale working bytes, and the file and HTTP Git remote
operations failed. The reference was used only as a black box.

The arm64 artifact was built natively on host-f after the smaller VM
builder killed its compiler. CI now runs the batch and MCP smoke test
after optimized builds on macOS and Linux. Workflow validation and all
package tests in this record ran locally or on the lab hosts.

Run the executable checks from the repository root.

```sh
python3 -B tests/release_smoke.py /path/to/unpacked/lit
python3 -B tests/remote_regression.py /path/to/unpacked/lit
python3 -B tests/authenticated_git_remote_regression.py /path/to/unpacked/lit
```
